selection_process: Selection is based on a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://www.jnkvv.org/ to download the details and application form format.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- via Demand Draft or online to the specified bank account and attach the proof of fee (except for SC/ST candidates).
Attach attested photographs and photocopies of documents to your application form.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate application forms along with an application fee of Rs. 100/- for each.
Attend the walk-in-interview on 15/10/2026 at 10:00 AM at PC Unit, JNKVV, Jabalpur.
Bring all relevant original documents along with the two sets of application forms at the time of interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Position is purely on temporary basis upto March, 2027, and is likely to be extended only after approval of the funding agency. The service can be terminated on one month notice from either side. The candidates must bring all the relevant original documents at the time of interview. Details for format of application can be obtained from https://www.jnkvv.org/.

faq.question: Q1. What is JNKVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Agricultural University (JNKVV) has announced a recruitment notification for 4 temporary contractual vacancies for Senior Research Fellow (SRF), Young Professional - I, Field Assistant, and Lab Assistant cum Computer Operator posts through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under JNKVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 temporary contractual vacancies available across various posts in the project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) is M.Sc. (Ag.) in Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the SRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit for SRF is 35 years as on the date of interview, with relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per rules.
